```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
breeding_site_locations <- read.csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(breeding_site_locations)
glimpse(breeding_site_locations)
migratory_connectivity <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
glimpse(migratory_connectivity)
bird_breeding_selected <- breeding_site_locations |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)
```
